summary: This note describes Buru Regency, a regency in the Indonesian province of Maluku. It occupies the northern half of Buru island, covers 4,932.32 square kilometres, and has its principal town at Namlea. The note gives population figures from the 2010 Census and a later official estimate from January 2014.
one_line: Buru Regency is an Indonesian regency in Maluku covering the northern half of Buru island, with its principal town at Namlea.
key_facts: Buru Regency is a regency of Maluku, Indonesia.
Buru Regency is located on the island of Buru.
Buru Regency comprises the northern half of Buru.
Buru Regency covers an area of 4,932.32 sq.km.
The population of Buru Regency at the 2010 Census was 108,445.
The latest official estimate for Buru Regency, as at January 2014, was 120,798.
The principal town of Buru Regency lies at Namlea.
